(20%)</p></li><li><p>Develop inspection plans and provide technical guidance to inspection personnel regarding product acceptance criteria, manufacturing processes, and quality requirements. (20%)</p></li><li><p>Conduct and support customer audits, source inspections, supplier quality reviews, and quality management system audits. (20%)</p></li><li><p>Perform advanced inspection activities and support inspection of complex assemblies, machined components, fabricated products, and electronic hardware when required. (15%)</p></li></ul><p></p><p><b>Representative Qualifications</b></p><ul><li><p>High school diploma, technical certification, Associate degree, or equivalent experience; bachelor’s degree
